newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's June CPI seen at 1.4/1.5 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy's June CPI seen at 1.4/1.5 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italy's June consumer prices index is forecast at 1.4/1.5 percent year on year and 0.0/0.1 percent month-on-month, according to analysts' forecasts after the last of 11 sample cities' data released on Monday.
This compares with a year-on-year rate of 1.6 percent and a month-on-month rate of 0.3 percent in May.
Analysts had forecast June inflation to stand at 0.2 percent month-on-month and 1.5-1.6 percent year-on-year.
Five sample cities released their data on Friday and a further six announced theirs on Monday. The 11 cities have a total weighting of 75.66 percent on the national index.
Statistics institute ISTAT will announce the final June figures on July 4.
